item.title: About
item.description: This is Junqi Yang’s personal space — an outlet for what I see, hear, and think. I love technology and history: the former gives me the “illusion” of transforming nature, while the latter satisfies my appetite for stories and gossip. In this day and age, thinking seems to have become an increasingly challenging task — perhaps one day the right to do it can even be handed over to AI. Under the impact and inducement of the flood of information, attention is endlessly consumed, and over time the mind seems to suffer as well. I refuse to be someone who merely drifts along in this flood, submitting to whatever comes. I would rather engage in effortful thinking, or simply express my own thoughts and experiences, and squeeze the results into words — even if it is performance art, it is a massage for the mind.
